annotations.title: Find model retirements and breaking changes

description: Reviewed AI platform changes from official vendor sources: model retirements and deprecations, breaking API changes, migration deadlines, access and price changes, each with the affected model ids, deadline, required action and sources. Use it to check whether a model id in your code is being retired.

query.description: Model id, product or keyword, e.g. claude-sonnet-4-5, Assistants API, gemini 2.5.

status.description: "open" means upcoming or active. Default any.
